Pertex ® Quantum: 41% recycled Pertex Quantum with Diamond Fuse shell fabric offers exceptional durability and abrasion resistance without adding weight. Diamond Fuse Technology: Pertex developed Diamond Fuse technology as a unique way of improving the durability and abrasion resistance of fabrics without adding any unnecessary weight.
